_comment: Extraction fields for this review. Edit freely — add, remove, or rename. 'requires' declares the minimum text needed: fields marked 'full-text' are left blank for abstract-only sources rather than guessed at.
review: AI and generative AI in management, business, and accounting education

fields.name: country
fields.prompt: Country or countries where the study was conducted. 'Multiple' if comparative, 'Not stated' if absent.

fields.name: discipline
fields.prompt: Disciplinary context of the education studied.

fields.name: study_design
fields.prompt: Research design. Conceptual pieces and reviews are not empirical — label them as such rather than forcing an empirical category.

fields.name: sample_size
fields.prompt: Number of participants or units analysed. Digits only, or 'Not stated'.

fields.name: ai_tool
fields.prompt: The specific AI system studied. Name it if named (ChatGPT, GPT-4, Copilot, Gemini); use 'generative AI (unspecified)' when the paper stays generic.

fields.name: application_area
fields.prompt: What the AI was used for in the educational setting.

fields.name: theory_used
fields.prompt: Named theoretical framework (TAM, UTAUT, constructivism, etc.). 'None stated' is a common and legitimate answer — do not infer a framework the paper does not name.

fields.name: outcomes_measured
fields.prompt: What outcomes or variables were measured or observed.

fields.name: key_findings
fields.prompt: The paper's main finding in one or two sentences, in its own terms. Not your assessment of it.

fields.name: limitations_stated
fields.prompt: Limitations the authors themselves acknowledge. Only what they state — not limitations you observe.
